title: FREEMEN OF THE LAND & THE MAGNA CARTA | Is Consent Required? | BlackBeltBarrister
summary: UK barrister explains why lockdown Magna Carta clause 61 signs and freeman-on-the-land consent arguments have no legal force.

assertions.quote: you cannot simply refuse to consent to the laws of parliament
if parliament creates a new written codified law that disagrees with one of the decisions of a court parliament's law takes precedence
there's been no instance of when such arguments have been held up in court
clause 61 which is what's being cited was never included in any subsequent version of the magna carta
there are only four commonly agreed clauses that remain in law from the magna carta today
